corrected_sources.publisher: Evernorth / GlobeNewswire press release mirrored by StockTitan
claims: Evernorth selected Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as inaugural institutional execution partners.
The company said institutional strategies would begin in Q4 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and required regulatory/corporate approvals.
The stated strategy is phased: institutional counterparties first, then XRP Ledger lending/on-chain credit only after validator activation and production proof.
CIO Hugo Jeandesboz joined from Coinbase Asset Management, where he served as co-CIO.
limitations: This is a mirrored press release, not evidence that any Q4 deployment has executed.
Partner agreements remain subject to closing conditions and approvals.

claims: Pathfinder/Company had a $7.0M Ripple revolving facility, amended October 7 to a $10.0M limit; $9.7M was borrowed as of October 7.

The $9.7M draw is at the subsidiary Company/Pathfinder level, not evidence of a $9.7M new XRP purchase; the facility required repayment within five business days after closing or earlier on five business days' demand by Ripple.
The separate Evernorth Facility was $1.0M and had no borrowings as of June 30, 2026.
Evernorth reported $30.0M of 4.00% convertible senior PIK notes issued October 12, 2026.
The Cantor committed equity facility covers up to 5,218,935 shares; the prospectus estimates up to approximately $80.7M gross only if all shares are sold at the assumed cover-page price.

As of October 22, 2026, 26,094,680 Class A shares were outstanding; the prospectus lists substantial additional potential shares from warrants, notes, units, Class C conversion, incentive plan and ESPP.

As of June 30, 2026, Evernorth reported $0.1M unrestricted cash and a $696.1M working-capital deficit before the October business combination; this is pre-close context, not the current post-close balance sheet.
limitations: The SEC filing does not establish that the $9.7M facility was still outstanding after the October 9 closing or whether it was repaid by the contractual due date.
The ELOC is discretionary and conditional; no draw or new XRP purchase from it is verified.
The Class A share count alone is not fully diluted shares or NAV per share.
